top_signals.title: China derails consensus on communiqué after US-hosted G20
top_signals.summary: Beijing objects to language calling for elimination of ‘non-market’ policies to curb trade imbalances
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bessent’s Bond Gains Wiped Out as 30-Year Yields Jump Once Again
top_signals.summary: The yields on the longest-dated US government bonds shot back to levels seen just before Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent shocked markets last month by expanding a buyback program in an effort to halt the rise.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
